summary: RopeSlice comparison cleared chunk1 before using its length to advance chunk2, leaving already-compared bytes in chunk2. Rope comparison delegates to this implementation, so comparing chunks ["a", "b"] against ["ac"] incorrectly returns Greater instead of Less. The fix advances chunk2 before clearing chunk1. The selected regression test was added by this fix; reproduction has not been run.
expected_failure:
assertion `left == right` failed
  left: Greater
 right: Less
